title: StockWatch: Korro Craters 81% on Data; Patient Death Sours Analysts on Intellia
summary: Korro reported data from its Phase I/IIa REWRITE clinical trial (NCT06677307) showing that its KRRO-110 generated functional M-AAT protein in AATD patients, but not enough as the company projected based on preclinical data.The postStockWatch: Korro Craters 81% on Data; Patient Death Sours Analysts on Intelliaappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
